<h2>Build Trait Analysis Release</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Freezes corrected VegVault trait records behind an explicit six-domain
analysis contract and records the reviewed unit and evidence status of
each domain.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_analysis_release(
  data_trait_records,
  data_trait_domain_units,
  vegvault_version,
  release_id,
  release_date
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Corrected classified trait records with 'trait_domain_name',
'trait_unit', and a numeric 'trait_value'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_domain_units">data_trait_domain_units</code></td>
<td>
<p>The validated trait-domain unit table of the release, as returned by
[validate_trait_domain_units()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vegvault_version">vegvault_version</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar VegVault version of the release (the 'vegvault_version'
of the 'config_vegvault_release' target).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="release_id">release_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar stable release identifier. It must start with
'vegvault_' and the version with underscores, for example
'vegvault_2_0_0_reviewed_2026_12_01'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="release_date">release_date</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar release date in ISO format ('YYYY-MM-DD').</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The release stops with an error when the unit table belongs to another
VegVault release, when 'release_id' names another release, when the
records or the unit table do not hold exactly the six supported domains,
or when a record's unit differs from the unit of its domain. The domain
statuses come from the reviewed unit table, not from this function.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A list containing the unchanged 'data_trait_records' and a
'data_trait_domain_status' tibble: the unit table with 'release_id' and
'release_date' in front, one row per domain.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[validate_trait_domain_units()], [load_trait_domain_units()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
build_trait_analysis_release(
  data_trait_records = data_traits_classified_corrected,
  data_trait_domain_units = data_trait_domain_units_validated,
  vegvault_version = "2.0.0",
  release_id = "vegvault_2_0_0_reviewed_2026_12_01",
  release_date = "2026-12-01"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
